Commentary.Commentary: Being 208/6 at Tea, one wondered whether the tourists will get to 300. But Matthew Wade stepped up and was well supported by the tailenders as he hit his 4th half century. David Warner also registered his maiden fifty of the series after getting a life. All the Indian bowlers were among the wickets and must be happy with their efforts. India will bat for one over. Be back in a bit.

After losing the toss, this Indian side has done tremendously well to dismiss Australia for 300. And the star has been the debutant Kuldeep Yadav. He picked four wickets and absolutely punctured the middle order of the visitors in the second session. But amidst the storm, it was Steven Smith doing his business as usual. He slammed his 20th Test ton, third of the series to show well he has been batting in these conditions.

The players are back out in the middle. Pat Cummins and Matthew Wade are out to bat. India begin the final session with Ravichandran Ashwin...
Day 1... Session 3....

Kuldeep ran through the Australian middle order, taking out Peter Handscomb and Glenn Maxwell - with a couple of beauties. Smith though carried on his merry way registering his third Test ton in the series. He was snapped up by Ashwin just at the stroke of Tea was the icing on the cake. India kept the runs down and that created pressure on the visitors. They will want to not let the lower order score much while Australia will hope for the opposite. Both teams have won a session each and it should be a cracking final session of the day. Join us in a while for it.

Cricket is a game of glorious uncertainties and if at the lunch interval, you could predict that India will go on to take 5 wickets in the second session, you need to buy yourself a lottery. Australia were coasting along at 144 for 1 before Kuldeep Yadav made a mark when he had Warner caught in the slips and things turned around for the hosts since then.

Fuller outside off, Smith gets across and defends it watchfully.
Shorter in length around off and middle, Smith lets it go over him with a duck.
Fuller outside off, defended watchfully by the batsman.
Good length around off, Smith gets back and across and defends it.
Length ball outside off, Peter punches it towards covers and takes a single to get off the mark.
Loopy on off, Smith comes forward and defends it. Top over from Kuldeep, a maiden!
This one is a touch short, Smith tucks it towards square leg off his crease.
Fuller on middle, Smith comes forward and defends it watchfully.
Floats it around off, comes in a touch, Smith comes forward and defends it.
Shorter outside off, Smith stays back and turns it towards short leg.
Too full on the stumps, Smith looks to clip but ends up finding the fielder at mid on.
Fuller outside off, Handscomb gets across and defends it.
Fuller and angling on the pads, Peter clips it towards square leg.
Peter Handscomb, the hero of the Ranchi Test, comes out to bat, replacing Shaun Marsh.

OUT! Soft dismissal for Shaun Marsh, unfortunate rather! Umesh slips one on a good length on the stumps, Marsh looks to help it on its way through. The ball though brushes off the edge of the bat and flies through to Saha who takes a good catch to his right. Umesh turns around to appeal and the umpire has ruled it out. Another wicket for India, not how they would have liked but they will take it happily.

A bit more wide outside off, this time Smith punches it wide of Pujara at short extra cover and takes a quick single. Pujara had to turn around to throw and that allowed Smith enough time to get into his crease at the non-striker's end.
Outside off on a length, Smith punches it towards covers from his crease.
Fuller outside off, Smith gets across and defends it back.
Flatter and faster on the stumps, Marsh stays back and defends it towards the leg side.
Marsh is watchful as he comes forward and keeps this one out.
Full toss outside off, Marsh comes down and clips it towards mid on. Karun Nair fires the throw at the striker's end as Marsh has to hurry back.
Smith whips one through mid-wicket and looks for a couple of runs. Murali Vijay there, gets to the ball and keeps them to a  single.
Too full on the pads, Marsh deflects it towards mid-wicket and takes a single. Leg Bye signaled as it came off the pads.
Full toss outside off, Marsh gets down and clips it towards mid on.
Angles it on a length, Marsh turns it towards square leg for a single. 150 up for Australia!
Outside off on a length, Smith works it off the inner half through backward square leg for a single.

Virat Kohli offers a drink to Kuldeep Yadav near the boundary ropes and has a word with him, maybe congratulates him on his maiden wicket and asks him to continue the good work. Nice to see that he is encouraging the players despite not playing.
Smith stays in his crease and defends it.
Marsh nudges one towards square leg for a single.
Slants it across on a length, left alone by Marsh.
Length ball around the stumps, Marsh defends it well.
Slips this one down the leg side, Smith looks to work it off his pads but misses. The ball goes towards fine leg, Rahane hares after it from first slip and keeps them to a couple. Leg Byes signaled.
This one is down the leg side, Marsh clips it towards mid-wicket for a single to get off the mark.
The googly comes out, outside off, Marsh does not read it, he gets across and reacts well to defend it.
Bowls it outside off, Marsh lets it go through.
Fuller on middle, Marsh keeps it out.
Shaun Marsh is the next man in.

OUT! Maiden Test wicket for Kuldeep Yadav thanks to a brilliant catch by Rahane! Lands it outside off, a touch short, Warner thinks - a boundary and goes to cut it. It is too close to cut and the ball goes off the outside edge straight to Ajinkya Rahane at first slip who takes it towards his right. Warner had earlier got a boundary, playing a similar shot, in the very first over of Kuldeep but this time the bowler gets the better off the batsman. That is how the game of cricket is! David Warner has to walk back after a good start and an ideal start for India post lunch. Kuldeep is delighted and why not, the entire Indian team is around him, celebrating what will be a memorable moment for him. The coach, Anil Kumble too applauds the effort.

FOUR! Top batting! Shorter in length around off, Smith gets on top of it and controls his pull through mid-wicket. Karun Nair at mid-wicket, tried to stop it with a dive but it was hit too well. Smith gets a boundary and Umesh spoils the good over with that boundary conceded. This has been a fine exhibition of batting by Steven Smith, he has made India change plans at the drop of the hat.
Pitched up outside off, Smith stays back, defends it with an open face of the blade towards covers.
Fuller in length just around off, Smith gets back and across and defends it.

Edged... but lands safe. Back of a length delivery, outside off, Smith tries to punch it but only manages an edge. But fortunately for him the ball lands well short of Rahane at gully. Luck favours the brave, they say and it has certainly been the case today.

FOUR! Now how do you explain that? Too full on off, Smith somehow manages to get it through mid-wicket. The timing is too good on this one and it is racing away towards the fence. KL Rahul comes across from deep mid-wicket, dives to keep the ball in play but ends up parrying it to the ropes. He seems to have hurt his fingers in the process as well.
Lands it outside off, on a good length, Smith plays inside the line of that one and is beaten.
Tossed up on middle, Warner drives it to extra cover from his crease.
Fuller on off, Warner comes forward and defends it.
Too full on middle, Warner pushes it towards the on side.
Lands it outside off, spins away, Warner lets it go watchfully.
Smith gets across and works one through the leg side for a single.
Bowls it on middle, Smith watches it closely and defends it watchfully towards the leg side.
Kuldeep Yadav to continue from the other end.

Shorter length ball but sliding down leg, Smith controls the pull and gets it towards long leg for a single. He seems to have hurt his right hand in the process. Replays show the impact with the ball was on the gloves more. That must have hurt Smith.
Shorter in length on the stumps, Smith ducks under it in time.
Fuller on the pads, Warner clips it to backward square leg for a single.
Good length on off, Smith works it through mid-wicket off the inner half for a single.
Fuller outside off, Warner pushes it to deep point for a single.
Good length on the stumps, Warner defends it watchfully from his crease.

The players are back out in the middle. The Indian team is in a much-needed huddle. They will aim to get back in the game with a few early wickets. Steven Smith and David Warner are out to bat. India begin the second session with Umesh Yadav! Here we go...
Day 1... Session 2......

India would rue the missed chance, Karun Nair was lazy and he dropped Warner on the very first ball of the game. Umesh did get the wicket of Renshaw but that was the only thing that went India's way. All the bowlers barring Ravindra Jadeja looked lost once Smith took the attack to them. India will aim to keep the runs down and hope to strike early after lunch to get back in the game. Join us in a while for the second session of play.

What a thumping start to the Test for Australia! They have scored as many as 131 runs in the first session itself and let India know that things are not going to be as easy as they might have expected to be. Both Smith and Warner have got to their fifties and with conditions ripe for batting, they will want to carry on the good work. While Warner has taken his time after being given a life, Smith has been his usual self, scoring at a brisk rate all the while.
Loops this one around middle, Smith clips it to mid-wicket. And that will be Lunch on Day One.

FOUR! Easily done. Fuller delivery, outside off, Smith leans forward and drives it uppishly between extra cover and mid off for a boundary. Cries of catch emerge from the slip cordon, but it was pierced through the gap perfectly.
Tossed up around leg, Smith blocks it towards the leg side.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Full and on the sticks, Smith looks to flick but it goes off the outer half of the bat to Kuldeep.
Flighted delivery, outside off, Smith drives it to mid off.
Looped up delivery, around leg, Smith nudges it through square leg. One run added to the total.
Tosses this one outside off, SS leans forward to defend.
Short and outside off, Smith rocks back in defense.
Floated delivery around leg, Warner clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up, outside off, Warner drives it towards covers.
Fuller and on middle stump, Warner makes room and drives it straight to short extra cover.
Floats this one around off, a hint of turn for Kuldeep, David cuts it with the turn to sweeper cover for one run.
Tossed up outside off, David cuts it towards point.
David has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Shortish and around off, the ball keeps low as David looks to cut. The ball hits the inner half of the willow and falls back on the pitch.
24th Test fifty for David Warner!

FOUR! Short and outside off, Warner looks to cut but it takes the outside edge and goes past the first slip for a boundary. Warner registers his first fifty of the series. He mentioned before the match, that he is timing the ball well. Just that he needs to hang around a bit more and he did exactly that today. But his work is not done here, he needs to bat on with his captain to take the game completely away from India.
Very full and around leg, Warner digs it out towards the bowler.
Time for the debutant, Kuldeep Yadav has the ball in his hands. The whole of India will be looking forward to him to get India back in the game here.
Short and around leg, Smith works it around down the leg side.
Similar length from Ashwin, this time around Warner cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.

FOUR! India are leaking runs. Commentators are mentioning the dropped catch of Warner on 0 and rightly so. Ashwin bowls short and outside off, David gets on his back foot and smashes it through covers for a boundary.
Loops this one on the sticks, Warner bunts it back to Ashwin.
Floats this one in the line of the off stump, Warner clears his front leg to block.
Tosses this one around middle, Warner nudges it towards the leg side.
Loops this one outside off, Smith defends it towards covers.
Full and on the sticks, SS knocks it back to the bowler.
Flights this one around off, Smith goes ahead to block.
Faster and flatter, on the sticks, Warner opens the face of the bat and plays it through point for a single.
FOUR! Short and duly punished. Jadeja drags his length back and keeps it outside off, Warner makes room for him and cuts it through covers for a boundary. Don't bother chasing it.
100-run stand between Warner and Smith!
Shortish and outside off, Smith rocks back and punches it through covers for a single.
Kuldeep is warming up! India need a wicket dearly, right now.
Warner has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

SIX! First maximum of the match. Flighted delivery in the line of the fourth stump, Warner clears his front foot and slams it over long off for a biggie. Warner is looking really confident now and is going for his shots.
Full and around middle, Warner offers a front foot defense.
Full and on the stumps, Smith flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Short and around leg, Smith nudges it to square leg.
Fuller and on the sticks, Smith flicks to mid-wicket.
Bowls it slower through the air and on the sticks, Warner bunts it back to the bowler.
Tossed up around off, Warner prods forward to defend it.
Full and on the sticks, Warner flicks it towards the mid-wicket region.
Short of a length delivery, outside off, DW cuts it towards the off side.

FOUR! Edged.. but lands safe! Fuller and outside off, Warner throws his hands at it and goes for a flashy drive. But the ball takes the outside edge and it goes through the left of Rahane, at first slip, for a boundary.
Short and spinning in, Warner defends it.
Tosses this one around middle, Smith flicks to mid-wicket.
FOUR! And again! Short and outside off, Steven rocks back and punches it through covers for a boundary. Brilliant stroke and Smith gets the wanted result.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.

FOUR! Excellent strike, that from Smudge! Floats this on the sticks, Smith dances down the track and slams it down the ground. The ball races away for a boundary in no time. Some intent this from Australia.
Tosses this one around off, Smith nudges it towards the leg side.
Faster and flatter, Smith leaves it alone.
Steven Smith is taking an off stump guard against Ashwin now.
Loops this one around off again, Warner leans forward to bury it.
Tossed up around off, Smith pushes it through cover-point for a single.
Short and around off, Smith goes back to defend.
Full and on the sticks, Smith clips it towards mid-wicket.
Floated delivery, outside off, SS pushes it towards the off side.
Tosses this one around off, Smith strides forward and defends it with an angled bat towards the leg side.
Fuller and on the sticks, Warner flicks it to mid-wicket.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Loops this one around off, David offers a front foot defense.
Floated delivery, around off, Warner is rock solid in defense.
Tossed up delivery and on the sticks, Warner offers a front foot defense.
Short and outside off, pushed to point.
Tossed up around off, SS defends it.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Smith has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

FOUR! Ashwin has been sloppy on the field, really. Jadeja bowls a fuller delivery, outside off, Smith tries to defend but it takes the outside edge and goes past Ashwin at short third man. He gives it a very casual chase and comes second.
Floated delivery around off, Smith looks to block but the ball whizzes past his outside edge.
Shorter delivery around leg, Smith tucks it through mid-wicket for a couple.
21st Test fifty for Steven Smith!
Well played, Smudge!  Tossed up around leg, Smith uses his feet and clips it to through the legs of forward short leg. What a counter-attacking innings this has been from the captain!
Shortish again and around middle, Smith clips it towards the leg side.
Short and on the sticks, Smith defends it.
Short and spinning in, Warner kneels and pulls it to long leg for a single.
Bowls it slower through the air, around leg, Warner looks to defend but gets rapped on the pads and the ball lobs towards point.
Tossed up delivery, around off, Warner offers a front foot defense.
Floated delivery, outside off, Smith leaves it alone.
Brilliant delivery! Bowls it slower through the air, Smith leans forward to block but gets beaten on the outside edge. Replays show that it pitched on the crack, hence the turn.
Full and around off, Smith defends it off the outer half of the bat towards point.
Short and on the sticks, Steven goes back and nudges it through mid-wicket for a brace.
Full and around leg, whipped to mid-wicket.
Tossed up around off, Smith moves across and whips it straight to Bhuvi at mid on.
Drags his length back and keeps it outside off, Warner rocks back and pushes it to covers. He wants a single, Smith doesn't. There is a misfield from the point fielder but they do not go for the run.
Fuller and on off, Warner leans forward to block.
Tosses this one around off, DW looks to defend but it takes the inside edge and goes onto hit his pads.
Tosses this on the sticks, Warner dead-bats it.
Flighted delivery, on middle, Warner makes room to drive it to covers.
Short and around leg, Smith tucks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Quicker and flatter, around off, Warner prods forward in defense.

ALMOST! Tosses this one around leg, Smith goes to defend but it bounces a bit more and it goes uppishly towards the leg side. There was no silly mid on and the batsmen run through for a single. There is a slight hesitation in the running as Warner was ball-watching there but no harm done in the end for Australia.
Floated delivery, around middle and leg, Smith defends it.
Tossed up around off, Smith looks to drive but it goes off the inner half of the bat towards the bowler.
Floated and on the sticks, bunted back to the bowler.
Bowls it slower through the air and around leg, clipped to mid-wicket.
Ravindra Jadeja comes on for a bowl. India will want him to stem the flow of runs first and then in the process, take a wicket!
Shortish and around leg, Smith nudges it through backward square leg. Single taken.
Flatter and on the sticks, Smith uses his feet to block.
Loops this one around off, defended back to the bowler.
Short and on the sticks, David makes room and drills it through covers. One run taken.
Floated delivery on middle, Warner clears his front leg to defend.
Tossed up around leg, Smith comes down the track and flicks it towards mid on for a single.
Fuller delivery, around off, Warner stonewalls it.
Good length delivery, way outside off, Smith just pushes it through point for an easy single. Bhuvi is bowling poor lines here.
Marginally ahead of length, around off, Smith drives it through covers for a brace.
Length ball, again outside off, Smith leave it alone and then again plays a pull shot. He has done that for the second time, wonder why?
Fuller delivery, outside off, left alone.

FOUR! Poor fielding effort, that! On a good length, outside off, Smith goes on his back foot and punches it through covers. Ashwin, at mid off, misjudges the pace of the ball and doesn't give it a proper chase. The ball races away for a boundary.
Drags his length back a touch to Warner and keeps it outside off, the southpaw rocks back and blocks it towards point.
Loops this one around middle, tucked through mid-wicket for a single.
Floated delivery, around leg, Smith uses his feet and flicks to mid-wicket.
Quicker and flatter, Warner drives to mid off and steals a quick single.
Fuller and on the sticks, Warner is rock solid in defense.
Tosses this one around off, Warner defends it off the front foot.
Back of a length delivery, around off, Smith camps back to block.
FOUR! Edged, but goes through! On a length, outside off, Smith looks to drive but it takes the outside edge and rolls past point for a boundary.
Fuller delivery, around off, Warner pushes it towards point. One run added to the total.
50-run partnership comes up between David Warner and Steven Smith.
Fullish delivery, outside off, Smith steers it down to third man for a single.
Fuller delivery, in the line of the fifth stump, left alone.
Marginally ahead of length, outside off, Smith mistimes his drive towards covers.

Drinks have been called. Barring Matt Renshaw's wicket, Australia have controlled the first hour. They have scored at a run rate of almost 5. The hosts will have to put brakes on their scoring rate as soon as possible to get back in the game.
Smith clips one through mid-wicket for a single.

In the air.....but safe! Loopy around off, Warner comes down to have a go. He does not connect well and gets it off the outer half towards point. A single taken. Warner wants to get going here. Replays show the ball spun off the crack there. Australia are really looking to put the pressure on India here.
Floats it on the stumps, Warner is right forward and defends it.
Warner comes down the wicket and pats it back to the bowler.
A touch slower, on the stumps, Warner looks to clip it through but misses. He is hit on his pads but that was going down leg.
Bowls it on middle and leg, Warner comes forward and defends it.
First bowling change. Ravichandran Ashwin comes into the attack.
FOUR! That raced away! Shorter length outside off, Smith flashes and flashes hard, he gets it down to the third man fence off the outer half. This is a magnificent start for Australia!
Smith works this one towards mid-wicket from his crease.
Full outside off, Smith comes forward and defends it.
Good length outside off, Smith punches it towards covers.
This one is guided towards point, wide enough of Pujara for a single.
Good stop! Pitched up outside off, Warner comes forward and times his push towards covers. Pujara goes to his right, dives and fields well and stops the batsmen from taking a single.
This one is outside off, driven through covers for a couple of runs. 7 runs off the over.
FOUR! Too easy! Fuller onto the stumps, Smith does not miss out and clips it through mid-wicket for a boundary. Brings up the 50 for Australia too!
Full outside off, Smith defends it towards covers.
Fuller outside off, Smith drives it towards Ravindra Jadeja at covers who gets surprised as the ball bounces more but he does well to not allow the single.
Full outside off, Warner pushes it towards covers for a single.
Too full outside off, Warner drives it towards mid off.
Goes wide of the crease, Smith drives it straight to extra cover.
Pitched up outside off, swings away, Smith raises his bat to let it go through.
Edged! Outside off on a length, Smith looks to defend but gets an outside edge which is well stopped by the gully fielder.
Angles it on a length outside off, Smith gets across and defends it.
Fuller outside off, Smith lets it go through.
Fuller outside off, left alone by the batsman.
Edged! Short again on the stumps, Smith looks to pull but gets it off the top edge, down to fine leg for a single.
Shorter in length on the stumps, Smith thinks about it at first but then lets it go with a sway.
Too full outside off, Smith guides it to sweeper cover for a couple of runs.
This one is wide outside off, left alone by Smith. He almost played a pull shot after leaving the ball, strange.

FOUR! Take that! Full and wide outside off, Smith does not miss out and throws his bat at it. The ball flies over extra cover for a boundary. India are not quite sure, where to bowl to Smith right now!
FOUR! Smith is on his merry way, yet again! Fuller outside off, Smith comes forward and times his push through cover-point. The ball races through the outfield and gets to the fence in a jiffy.
Full outside off, Warner comes forward and times his push to covers.

FOUR! That bounced! Hurls it outside off on a good length, the ball bounces a lot more, Warner looking to play it, gets surprised and the ball lobs over the slip cordon off the edge and runs into the third man fence.
Warner is right forward and defends this one watchfully.
Fuller in length, Warner gets in line and defends it.
This time it is on the stumps, Warner gets behind it and defends it.
FOUR Leg Byes! Poor ball! Hurls it on a good length but outside leg, Warner fails to clip it through. The ball runs down to the fine leg fence off the thigh pad. Leg Byes signalled.
Warner hops a touch and defends it for a single towards covers.
Length ball on the stumps, Warner defends it watchfully from his crease.
Hold on, it looks like it is not. The third umpire is out and they have changed the cherry, India were not happy with the shape of it.
The umpire is having a look at the ball. It is going through the hoop for now, so it is okay. Virat Kohli is on the field, with drinks in the meanwhile.
Outside off on a good length, Smith defends it towards covers for a quick single.
Goes round the wicket, bowls it on a length, Smith defends it off the inner half through square leg for a couple.
Edged! Fuller in length around the stumps, Warner shapes to defend but gets it off the outside edge towards point. One run added to the total.
Fuller outside off, Warner comes forward and defends it to covers.
Full outside off, driven sweetly towards Ashwin at mid off.
Angles it full outside off, Smith defends it watchfully. The ball goes off the inside edge and almost goes through between his legs and just wide of the stumps.
Bowls it around the wicket on the pads, Smith clips it through mid-wicket for another brace.
Angles it on the stumps, Smith plays his trademark clip and gets a couple through mid-wicket.
Defends it from his crease watchfully.
Fuller outside off, Smith mistimes his drive towards mid off.
FOUR! Warner times one well! Outside off on a length, Warner opens the face of the bat and gets it through cover-point for a boundary. Superb timing on that occasion.
Good length outside off, Smith works it through mid-wicket for a single to get off the mark.
Slants it on a good length on the stumps, Smith raises his bat and gets out of the way. Saha dives to his left and stops the ball.
A touch short on the stumps, Warner tucks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Hurls it on the stumps, Warner defends it towards mid on from his crease with a forward press.
Edged! Fuller in length on the stumps, Warner shapes to defend but gets an outside edge towards point.
Angling into the stumps, Smith looks to clip it but gets it towards covers. That would have been a leading edge but Smith managed to open the face of the bat at the last moment, I have no idea how!
Goes wide of the crease, angles it around off, Smith defends it taking the bottom hand off the bat.
Full outside off, swings away, Smith gets across and defends it.
Angling into the stumps, Warner gets an inside edge onto his pads and through square leg for a single.
Fuller and angling on the stumps, Warner clips it towards the leg side but not for any runs.
Fuller in length around off, comes in late, Warner does well to react to it and defends it watchfully towards covers.
Fuller outside off, Smith lets it go through.
Back of a length around the stumps, Smith raises his bat and lets it go. The ball swings in late and Saha has to adjust and he does well to take it.
Australian skipper Steven Smith strolls out in the middle to replace Matt Renshaw.

OUT! TIMBER! Fuller in length around off, Renshaw plays outside the line and the ball nips back in. The ball brushes the pad and goes onto disturb the stumps. Umesh strikes for India and that should relax the Indian team. India will want to make most of this conditions. Renshaw has been scoring a lot  for Australia and India will be happy to see the back  of him, early.
A back of a length delivery on the stumps, Renshaw stands tall and defends it.
Slight hold up in play as there is an issue with the sightscreen.
Length ball outside off, Renshaw guides it towards point.
Hurls it outside off, Renshaw plays inside the line of the ball and lets it go through.
Umesh Yadav will bowl from the other end. A short leg has been deployed.
FOUR! Fetch that! Full outside off, Warner gets low and drills it through extra cover for a boundary. Superb start for Australia!
Fuller in length on the stumps, Renshaw clips it towards Ashwin at mid on. The single was always on and the fielder fumbled and allowed the single.
Brings this one into Renshaw from around off, Renshaw keeps it out watchfully.
Angles it on a length, Warner works it off his hips towards square leg for a single.
Fuller outside off, left alone by Warner.

FOUR! Dropped! What a start, would have been a wicket on arrival for Bhuvneshwar! Fuller outside off, swinging away, Warner goes for the drive away from his body, Karun Nair lunges to his left and grabs at it but cannot hold onto it. The ball runs down to the third man fence. Oh dear, would have been an ideal start for India, you don't want to give Warner an early life.

The Indian team are in a huddle and the country's 33rd Test captain Ajinkya Rahane is giving a pep talk before they take their positions. David Warner and Matt Renshaw are out at the centre too. Rahane tosses the new ball to Bhuvneshwar Kumar. 3 slips and a gully in place.

India skipper, Ajinkya Rahane informs that Virat Kohli has opted out since he is not 100 percent fit. Informs that they were looking to bat first as well. Does not expect the deck to change much. Informs that they are playing five bowlers as he expects the pitch to be good for the first few days. Confesses the preparations have been good and is confident of players stepping up in the absence of Virat Kohli.

Australia skipper, Steven Smith informs that they will bat first. Admits that the stage is really set for the decider, it is a beautiful place to play. States that the facilities have been really good and the pitch is good, he informs. Thinks that the deck has a more covering of grass compared to other venues. Expects more bounce but also adds that he has been wrong in assessing the pitch so can't be sure. Says that there are a bit of cracks which will help the spinners.

TOSS - Australia win the toss and opt to bat! Australia are unchanged. India have made a couple of changes - Kuldeep Yadav comes in for Virat Kohli while Ishant Sharma is dropped for Bhuvneshwar Kumar.

Hello and welcome to the first day of the fourth and the final Test of this series between India and Australia. First things first, the big news has arrived. Virat Kohli has not fully recovered and will miss out on the decider. In his absence, it will be Ajinkya Rahane who will lead the side. Coming to the other talking points, Kuldeep Yadav has received his Test cap and will make his debut. A move that must have been taken keeping Ravichandran Ashwin and Ravindra Jadeja's workloads in mind. A lot of responsibility now falls on Karun Nair and Rahane who have had a quiet series so far. As far as Australia are concerned, they will look to play the same side as all the players have performed to their potential. Let's find out more at the toss.
